newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish air cargo traffic up five pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Spanish air cargo traffic up five pct in Sept.

text.p: Air cargo traffic at the 39 airports managed by AENA (Spanish Airports and Air Navigation), rose 5.36 percent in September compared with the same month a year ago, AENA said.

Of the total 39,230 tonnes of cargo that passed through Spanish airports last month, international traffic made up 22,023 tonnes, up 9.68 percent, and domestic traffic 17,207 tonnes, an increase of 0.30 percent.
The accumulated total for the first nine months of the year now stands at 355,646 tonnes, 8.79 percent higher than 1995.
Passenger numbers were 3.69 percent higher at 10.56 million, taking the total to 79.95 million so far this year, 4.93 percent ahead of last year.
Air transport movements were up nearly seven percent to 122,486 in the month. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
